title: ARSIA Message
description: Message envelope for the ARSIA Protocol v1.0. Runtime constraints not expressible in JSON Schema: (1) When a receiving agent downgrades capabilities (Actions §1.3), the response MUST include effective_capabilities in payload.result. This array MUST be a subset of the original request's capabilities and MUST contain at least one capability. Enforced at runtime — schema cannot validate cross-message state. (2) Rollback requests (Actions §4.2) use intent 'request' with payload.type formatted as '{action_id}/rollback'. The payload.args SHOULD include original_message_id. This is a naming convention, not a distinct wire format. (3) Long-running actions (Actions §4.3) SHOULD use the asynchronous execution pattern. The initial response uses intent 'response' with payload.result containing status_url. Status polling responses are separate HTTP GET responses outside the ARSIA message envelope.

transport-error-response.description: Machine-readable transport-level error body per Core §11.1.1. Used for HTTP-level errors (401, 403, etc.) outside the ARSIA message envelope.

required_capabilities.description: All capabilities from the message's capabilities field

provided_capabilities.description: Capabilities present in the token's scope

unsupported_type.description: SHOULD be included when error is due to unsupported payload type — Core §11.2

error-details-service-unavailable-reside.description: Error details for service_unavailable caused by data residency violation — Core §11.2, Routing §1.2.2, §7.3 Rule 2

allOf.description: Broker's actual jurisdiction when rejecting for zone mismatch — Routing §7.3 Rule 2

available_zones.description: Zones the implementation can serve — Routing §1.2.2

error-details-certificate.description: Error details for certificate errors (certificate_invalid, certificate_expired, key_mismatch, certificate_revoked) — Identity §6.4.3

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the certificate verification failure

error-details-relay-failed.description: Error details for broker relay failure — Routing §2.3.3, §7.3

allOf.description: Unique identifier for the relay operation

original_error.description: Recipient's error when relay failed due to recipient error

error-details-rate-limited.description: Error details for rate_limited — Core §11.2. All fields SHOULD-level.

allOf.description: Timestamp when the rate limit resets

error-details-payload-too-large.description: Error details for payload_too_large — Core §11.2. All fields SHOULD-level.

error-details-conflict-version.description: Error details for conflict caused by optimistic concurrency — State §8.4

error-details-oversight-denied.description: Error details for forbidden caused by human oversight denial — Actions §3.4 Path 2, §6 ACTIONS-06

approver_id.description: Agent-id of the approver who denied the action

reason.description: Human-readable reason from the approval_decision, or null

error-details-oversight-expired.description: Error details for forbidden caused by approval deadline expiry — Actions §3.4 Path 3, §6 ACTIONS-07

allOf.description: The approval_deadline timestamp that was exceeded

error-details-rollback-conflict.description: Error details for conflict when rolling back an already rolled-back action — Actions §4.2

error-details-rollback-partial.description: Details for partial rollback response — Actions §4.2

not_rolled_back.description: Effects that could not be reversed

pending-approval-args.description: Payload args for pending_approval intent — Actions §3.2

allOf.description: The id of the original request message
Latest time approval will be accepted — must equal envelope expires_at

context.description: Human-readable description of the action for the approver

summary.description: Human-readable summary of the operation for the approver. MUST be present for financial operations per ARSIA-Assets.md §5.2.

approval-decision-result.description: Payload result for approval_decision intent (oversight) — Actions §3.3

approver_id.description: Agent-id or identifier of the approving entity

reason.description: Human-readable explanation — RECOMMENDED when decision is denied

long-running-status.description: Status response for long-running actions — Actions §4.3

allOf.description: Correlation identifier for request-response pairs (UUID v4)

enc_alg.description: JWE key agreement algorithm (Core §5.3). RECOMMENDED: ECDH-ES. Also permitted: ECDH-ES+A256KW (MAY), RSA-OAEP-256 (MAY). Implementations SHOULD default to ECDH-ES unless interoperability requires an alternative.

enc_method.description: JWE content encryption algorithm (Core §5.3). The only defined value is A256GCM. Future spec versions may define additional methods.

compliance.description: Compliance metadata for this message. See arsia-compliance-field.schema.json for the full definition. additionalProperties is enabled by design to support profile-specific extension fields.

code.description: Standard ARSIA error code or application-specific code in reverse domain notation. Standard codes use snake_case (e.g. invalid_request). Custom codes use dot-separated reverse domain notation with hyphens (e.g. com.example.insufficient-funds). Per ARSIA-Core.md §11.2.

oneOf.description: JWE compact serialization when security.encrypted = true
